title: Philippine House Officials Urge NTC, DICT to Block Facebook Pages Spreading China-Aligned West Philippine Sea Disinformation
detail: House impeachment adviser Rep. Robert Ace Barbers said on August 23, 2026 that the National Telecommunications Commission should block China-aligned misinformation pages 'the same way that government cracks down on porn sites,' singling out the Facebook page Media Unlocked for spreading a video that falsely characterized a Philippine West Philippine Sea resupply incident as 'staged drama.' Sen. Leila de Lima, Senior Deputy Minority Leader, said 'we condemn this kind of content that clearly peddle fake news and disinformation about what is really happening in the [WPS]' and called on the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) to monitor such pages and strengthen collaboration with digital platforms. Rep. Terry Ridon, of the House Committee on Public Accounts, urged the Department of National Defense and National Security Council to flag misinformation pages and request their removal from social media platforms. Officials said the NTC and DICT have authority to coordinate with internet service providers to block malicious domains.

media.caption: House officials call for the NTC and DICT to block Facebook pages spreading China-aligned disinformation about the West Philippine Sea
